items.proposed: 1p/19q codeletion (with IDH mutation): CNS5-defining exclusion, exempt from any_molecular_selection; candidate_matched false
items.reason: 'known IDH1 or IDH2 mutations or 1p/19q co-deletion' excludes tumours only to define CNS5 glioblastoma, which D31-A5 exempts; any_molecular_selection stays true through the EGFR-low entry requirement.

items.coder_A: EGFR-low selection is specific to ONC201 in this trial, but the record states no mechanistic link between EGFR and ONC201 (a DRD2 antagonist); could be judged a predictive candidate-matched selection.
items.reason: Entry requires 'absence of EGFR gene amplification... absence of EGFRvIII... low EGFR expression', and the trial is titled 'ONC201 in Adults With EGFR-low Glioblastoma', but the record only describes ONC201 as 'a orally active, small molecule DRD2 antagonist' and states no mechanistic link between EGFR and ONC201.

Exclusion 'known IDH1 (isocitrate dehydrogenase 1) or IDH2 mutations' plus 'World Health Organization Grade IV glioblastoma'; treated as an IDH-wildtype requirement, consistent with other records, but exclusion covers only known mutations.
Two EXPERIMENTAL arms (Arm A with surgical resection, Arm B), both ONC201, neither a control; R8 defines 'no' for more than one arm with no control and 'not_applicable' only for single-arm trials.

note: A6 pending XL: whether the EGFR-low entry requirement is candidate-matched to ONC201 (record states no EGFR link; ONC201 is described only as 'a orally active, small molecule DRD2 antagonist'); candidate_matched kept false as proposed, and this decides the primary outcome. cns5 vs unclear is also low confidence (only known IDH mutations are excluded). tumour_pk_planned stays yes (intra-tumoral ONC201 concentrations).

revisions.from: 1p/19q codeletion: eligibility (exclusion), candidate_matched false; no effect on outcomes
revisions.to: 1p/19q codeletion (with IDH mutation): CNS5-defining exclusion, exempt from any_molecular_selection; candidate_matched false
revisions.reason: The exclusion of 'known IDH1 or IDH2 mutations or 1p/19q co-deletion' only defines CNS5 glioblastoma and is exempt from any_molecular_selection.
Arm A will explore 'pharmacodynamic activity', but no pharmacodynamic measurement is described (only intra-tumoral concentrations and ORR are registered outcomes).
